verdict.rationale: Featurebase's core product is a hosted feedback portal (featurebase-docs-15) that can be embedded via widgets in-product/on-site and served from a custom domain (featurebase-docs-8, featurebase-docs-9, featurebase-docs-17), implying a straightforward way to link/direct users to it. However, there is no explicit documentation snippet showing a simple 'add this link/button' setup flow or code sample for developers. Missing for 10: explicit developer-facing instructions or SDK snippet for embedding a portal link/button, and independent confirmation of ease of integration.
